599:t_128:0.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$! You are a being that snuffs out humanity's potential!」

599:t_128:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$マリーダ・クルス$$, is it? So even you stand against me.」

599:t_128:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I bet everything on the light that leads to the future! A light that will not lose to your nothingness!」

599:t_128:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That is an illusion, $$マリーダ$$. It is a rather rough method, but this $$ネオ・ジオング$$ will teach it to you by force.」

599:t_129:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「The world you lead has no peace.」

599:t_129:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Let me hear your grounds for that.」

599:t_129:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「It's simple. A man who doesn't understand the weight of a human life can't understand the meaning or value of peace.」

599:t_129:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That's why, $$フル・フロンタル$$...! I won't hand the world over to you...!」

599:t_130:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「A machine that threw away mobility for firepower? To me, that's an easy target!」

599:t_130:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But once you enter this $$ネオ・ジオング$$'s range, there is no escape.」

599:t_130:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't think the world or I will go the way you want! My wings will fly beyond whatever you expect!」

599:t_131:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「You're bottling your feelings up inside! Let it all out and listen to my song!!」

599:t_131:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even I am being overawed...?」

599:t_131:2.en:
$$バサラ$$
「It's not someone else's song! Try singing your own! That feels way better!」

599:t_131:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「So you deny my very existence, it seems.」

599:t_132:0.en:
$$レド$$
「What you're trying to do is the same as $$ストライカー#robot$$! You're trying to take people's freedom with pleasant-sounding words!」

599:t_132:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Whether one calls it domination or stable governance depends on the person. At the very least, I myself strive to be a good guide.」

599:t_132:2.en:
$$レド$$
「A man who moves the army and suppresses opposition by force is no good ruler!」

599:t_132:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It seems you too are a human who cannot welcome me with reason.」

599:t_132:4.en:
$$レド$$
「I believe in what I feel! That feeling tells me you are the enemy!」

599:t_133:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「You, the leader, taking the field yourself is the greatest tactical error.」

599:t_133:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Soldiers do not follow a man who does not stand on the front line.」

599:t_133:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「That arrogance will end your ambition!」

599:t_133:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Do that after you defeat me...」

599:t_133:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're wide open! Your other mistake is running your mouth on the battlefield!」

599:t_134:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Compared to your $$ゼロ・レクイエム$$, I believe my way is mild.」

599:t_134:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I agree with that. But I cannot tolerate a method that robs people's future of hope in exchange for sparing them pain.」

599:t_134:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I cannot go along with your romanticism. Neither can I... nor can humanity.」

599:t_134:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It is neither you nor I who will choose that, but each and every human being.」

599:t_134:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I will fight to stop you, who would take even that freedom away! As one of the people living in this world!」

599:t_135:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The world I lead will not be accepted by $$ＡＴ$$ pilots, who can live only in battle.」

599:t_135:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Don't decide how I live on your own.」

599:t_135:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I'll stop you by my own will. You can't create a future.」

599:t_136:0.en:
$$桂$$
「I can't stand guys like that, hauling out some obvious secret weapon just because it's the final battle.」

599:t_136:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Just as I am a vessel of humanity's collective will, this $$ネオ・ジオング$$ is a vessel that receives people's wishes.」

599:t_136:2.en:
$$桂$$
「Then let's smash that so-called vessel! In grand style, with a big crash!」

599:t_136:4.en:
$$桂$$
「Thinking you've already won like that is one of the habits of a villain!」

599:t_136:5.en:
$$桂$$
「Be ready for this, $$フル・フロンタル$$! I'm ending you here!」

599:t_137:0.en:
$n
「Now that the target's bigger, my attacks will land! After that, I'll push through with sheer power!」

599:t_137:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Naive. You will pay the price for underestimating this $$ネオ・ジオング$$'s firepower.」

599:t_137:2.en:
$n
「It seems your ego grew along with your machine.」

599:t_137:3.en:
$n
「I'll knock down your prized machine and break your confidence!」

599:t_137:4.en:
$n
「By doing that, I'll stop you and this war right here!」

599:t_138:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$! Today is the day!」

599:t_138:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Why can't you understand how dangerous it is to fight over a personal grudge like that!」

599:t_138:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We... humanity... can't afford to be doing things like that!」

599:t_138:3.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I have no more use for that Gundam! You, who have kept being insolent to the Colonel, will be eliminated here!」

599:t_138:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「My voice isn't reaching him...!」

599:t_138:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But I... I can't stop moving forward here!!」

599:t_139:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You, the $$ユニコーン$$, $$シャア$$, $$アムロ$$, every enemy of the Colonel, I will eliminate them all!」

599:t_139:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You...! Will you fight only for $$フロンタル$$ to the very end!」

599:t_140:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「This is as far as you go, $$セツコ$$! I can't let you people advance any further!」

599:t_140:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$...! I won't hesitate to fight you!」

599:t_140:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If my $$スフィア$$ can become the power to stop your $$スフィア$$, I'll use it!」

599:t_140:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I will overcome my sorrow...! I won't let you spread any more hatred!」

599:t_141:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Even as we speak, your beloved Miss $$スズネ$$ is fading away inside $$アムブリエル$$.」

599:t_141:3.en:
$n
「You're the same as $$ギルター$$. Since you can't win head-on, you resort to cowardly mental pressure.」

599:t_141:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Do you think I'd fall for such a transparent provocation?」

599:t_141:5.en:
$n
「Don't lump me in with you. I have no intention of using such a cheap trick.」

599:t_141:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「This guy...! Always talking back!」

599:t_141:7.en:
$n
「Are you ready, $$バルビエル$$! I'll crush you head-on!!」
